title: grai.config.json
description: A grai project's config, which the CLI, the Vite plugin and the adapters all read. Paths are relative to it.

locales.description: The project's locales, as BCP 47 tags in their canonical form: "en-US", not "en-us".

baseLocale.description: One of "locales": the one the others are translated from, whose text the editor shows and grai seed copies, and the locale a request gets when its strategy finds none.

catalogs.description: Each locale's catalog, a path with {locale} in it, or a list of distinct such paths, where a locale's messages are split across files: a key is in one of them, and a new key goes in the first.

outdir.description: Where the compiled output goes: a directory of grai's own.

strategy.description: Where the server and a page no server draws look for the locale, in order, before the base locale: the cookie, the page's localStorage, the request's Accept-Language or the browser's languages, the URL's query parameter, the URL's first path segment.

cookieName.description: The cookie the "cookie" strategy reads and setLocale writes, when "strategy" lists "cookie": a name RFC 6265 allows. A __Secure- or __Host- name makes the cookie Secure.

cookieMaxAge.description: The seconds a browser keeps the locale cookie, 400 days by default, which is the most a browser keeps one.

cookieDomain.description: A host whose subdomains share the locale cookie, without a scheme, a port, a path or a leading dot. Not with a __Host- name, which a browser keeps for one host.

cookieSameSite.description: The locale cookie's SameSite: "lax", the default, "strict", or "none" for a page embedded in another site's, which makes the cookie Secure.

localStorageKey.description: The key in localStorage the "localStorage" strategy reads and setLocale writes, when "strategy" lists "localStorage".

queryParameter.description: The URL's query parameter the "query" strategy reads and setLocale names the locale in, when "strategy" lists "query", such as "lng" for ?lng=de.

switch.description: How a page changes locale: "reload", the default, reloads it. "live", where a page would change in place, is refused until grai does it.

localePrefix.description: With the "url" strategy: "as-needed", the default, where the base locale's paths have no prefix, or "always", where every locale's have one.

localePrefixes.description: With the "url" strategy: a locale's prefix of its own, one path segment of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; a locale's prefix is otherwise its tag.

unlocalizedPaths.description: With the "url" strategy: globs, of *, **, ? and {a,b}, of the paths it leaves alone, which have no prefix and whose locale the strategies after "url" find.

pathnames.description: With the "url" strategy: a route's path in each locale's words, which localizeHref writes and deLocalizeUrl reads back as the route. A path starts with /, a segment written [name] is carried across, and each locale's path names the route's segments.

basePath.description: With the "url" strategy: the path the app is served under, which the locale's prefix follows, such as "/shop". It starts with / and does not end with one. The framework's base path must be the same: Vite's base, SvelteKit's paths.base, Next's basePath or Astro's base.

domains.description: With the "url" strategy: every locale's own host, each its own, such as { "en": "example.com", "de": "example.de" }. There a request's host names its locale, paths have no prefix, and a link to another locale is a whole URL. On any other host, such as localhost in development, the prefix names the locale.

tests.description: Globs, of *, **, ? and {a,b}, of the source files that are tests, by path from the root, which grai check does not count as using a key. [] makes no file a test.

identicalToBase.description: Per locale other than the base, the keys whose message rightly reads as the base locale's, such as a unit, which grai check and grai export take as translated.

fallbacks.description: Each locale that takes the messages it lacks from another locale of its language, never the base locale. Its catalog may then hold only the messages that differ.

pseudoLocale.description: A locale made from the base's messages, for development and tests, which no build ships: a BCP 47 tag in its canonical form that "locales" does not list, with the base's plural categories.

descriptions.description: A JSON file of each key's description for translators: grai export writes each as a note of the key's units, and grai import fills it from FormatJS's descriptions.
